description.narrative: Component 1: Support for Management Transformation of MEP and Modernization of its Information Systems. This component will support the management transformation of the Ministry of Public Education (MEP) to improve efficiency. It will include a subcomponent focused on the inventory, evaluation and reform of the MEP's administrative structure and processes and a subcomponent on information systems modernization. This component will finance consultancies, development and acquisition of software, cloud implementation activities and related licensing and technical assistance. Component 2: Support for Pedagogical Transformation. Component 2 will support the pedagogical transformation of the education system, to better deliver foundational skills and build strong bases for the acquisition of digital competencies. The first subcomponent will focus on foundational skills of early reading and numeracy, and the second one on supporting hybrid learning and digital competencies. This component will finance technical assistance (firms and individuals), procurement of didactic materials, and a managed service provide (MSP) contract for provision of secure and up to date computational services to MEP administered schools. Component 3: Support for Employability and Inclusion in Education Programs. Component 3 will support the delivery of employability related competencies to students in the technical stream of Secondary education, English learning for all students and improving educational quality at schools serving indigenous communities, migrants and refugees. The first subcomponent will focus on employability skills, while the second one will be dedicated to developing targeted programs for indigenous and migrant students. This component will finance consultancies, technical assistance and printing costs and acquisition of software. Component 4. Project Management and Technical Assistance. Component 4 will finance project management costs and technical assistance.
The Project Development Objective is to enhance MEP efficiency and improve foundational learning, digital competencies and employability skills of students in MEP administered schools.
